issues: Activated ability cost is encoded incorrectly. Replace the nonstandard cost fields with a valid activated cost using banishFromExArea, e.g. {"cost":{"banishFromExArea":{"filter":{"identityName":"Repair Mode"},"count":2}}}, while keeping the effect that grants this follower Storm.

details.effect: [quick] You may play this card for 5 more play points. Select an enemy follower on the field and banish it. If you played this card for 5 more play points, instead of banishing that follower, banish each enemy follower on the field.

options.label: Pay 5 more play points to banish each enemy follower instead

issues: The upgraded mode should banish each enemy follower on the field, but it is encoded as a normal single-target banish with no count limit. Change the second choose option effect to use banishUpTo with maxCount large enough to cover all enemy followers, or another implemented all-enemy-follower banish encoding, while keeping additionalPpCost: 5.

details.effect: [fanfare] Look at the top card of your deck. If it's a Cool card, you may reveal it and add it to your hand. [act] [cost00]: Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 1 damage. Activate only if there are at least 3 Cool followers on your field, and only once per turn.

issues: Keywords incorrectly include quick; the source text does not give this card Quick. Remove "quick" from keywords.

The fanfare is encoded too broadly. It should look only at the top card of your deck and add it to hand only if that specific card is a Cool card; the current searchDeckChoose could take any Cool card from the looked-at cards. Encode the top-card check so only the top card can be revealed and added.
